subject: NimbleCare private-offer acceptance + seat uplift (invoice split question)
messages:
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimblecare.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-16T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: NimbleCare private-offer acceptance + seat uplift (invoice split question)

Jordan —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our conversation, NimbleCare is ready to accept the AWS private offer but wants to confirm a couple of operational details before we route the DocuSign: specifically, the seat uplift (+150 seats) and the preferred invoice breakup for FY28.

Quick summary of what I attached: 1) NimbleCare_PO_DRAFT_20270816.pdf — a one-page PO with the uplift and updated pricing, 2) proposed addendum lines for SLA and data residency.

As discussed, NimbleCare prefers two invoices (50% at acceptance, 50% at 90 days) rather than a single annual invoice. That is doable but will require coordination with our finance billing flow and the marketplace acceptance window. Can you confirm:
- Who on your procurement team will sign the PO?
- Any PO number or internal code we should include on the invoice?
- Can legal accept a short SLA addendum (I attached a redline suggestion)?

If procurement wants a multi-tranche invoice, we can route the private-offer acceptance with a billing note and share a DocuSign link that includes the tranches in the payment terms. I cc'd Marissa and Ben to help with the acceptance and invoice routing.

Next steps I suggest:
- Jordan confirms PO signatory and invoice cadence by end of day tomorrow.
- Marissa prepares the DocuSign with the two-tranche invoice language and flags tax/regional items for Neha.
- Ben will surface any marketplace acceptance timing constraints if we need to stagger capacity activation.

Thanks — talk soon.

--
Dylan Brooks
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
D: +1 415-555-0124 | dylan.brooks@redwood.ai
Redwood Inference

Attachments:
- NimbleCare_PO_DRAFT_20270816.pdf (pdf, 1 page, draft)
- SLA_addendum_NimbleCare.docx (docx, redline suggested)

From: Jordan Lee <jordan.lee@nimblecare.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement Team <procure@nimblecare.com>, Maya Patel <maya.patel@nimblecare.com>
Date: 2027-08-16T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCare private-offer acceptance + seat uplift (invoice split question)

Thanks Dylan — appreciate the clear summary.

Quick answers:
- Procurement will sign; I'll loop in our procurement lead (procure@nimblecare.com) for signature authority.
- PO number: NC-PO-2789. Please include it on all invoice lines.
- SLA addendum: Legal will review; high-level they want explicit uptime targets for the first 6 months after uplift and a service credits clause. I added Maya on this thread — she is our security/compliance contact and will capture any data residency notes.

We are fine with the 2-tranche invoice split (50/50) but Procurement asked whether the first invoice can be dated for the current fiscal month and the second as a delayed invoice at day 90 — they want the cash flow split aligned to FY28 planning. If Redwood needs the marketplace acceptance date to be contiguous with invoice date we need to understand any activation windows.

We reviewed the PO draft and a couple of small asks from our side (copied below):
- Please add NC-PO-2789 to the PO header.
- Add a line that the 150-seat uplift will start on the acceptance effective date and prorate for the remainder of FY28.

I can get procurement to sign by Friday if the DocuSign and invoices are ready.

Jordan
VP Product Operations | NimbleCare

From: Procurement Team <procure@nimblecare.com>

Cc: Maya Patel <maya.patel@nimblecare.com>
Date: 2027-08-17T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: NimbleCare private-offer acceptance + seat uplift (invoice split question)

Hi Dylan / Jordan,

Procurement here — we can sign NC-PO-2789 once a couple of items are clarified.

1) Invoice split: We confirm 50/50 is acceptable but request the invoice terms explicitly call out the due dates and the invoice references our PO number. We will need the first invoice to be dated 2027-08-31 and the second invoice dated 2027-11-29 (90 days) for internal cash planning.

2) SLA addendum: Legal reviewed the redline. Two asks: (a) include a 99.5% uptime target for the first 6 months after uplift, (b) a 30 day remediation window for any functional regressions introduced by the uplift.

3) Marketplace activation: We will accept activation to start on the acceptance effective date; however, we request that seat provisioning for the 150-seat uplift be staged over the first 14 calendar days to avoid user disruption. Please confirm Redwood can support staged enablement via the marketplace pool.

Attached: SLA_addendum_NimbleCare.docx (redline).

If those items are in the DocuSign and the PO header contains NC-PO-2789 we will route signatures today.

Regards,
Procurement Team
NimbleCare

Attachments:
- SLA_addendum_NimbleCare.docx (docx, redline requested)

From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2027-08-19T15:40:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: NimbleCare private-offer acceptance + seat uplift (invoice split question)

Team —

Forwarding the procurement email from NimbleCare. They will sign once we include NC-PO-2789, add the two-tranche invoice dates, accept the SLA redline asks (99.5% for 6 months + 30-day remediation), and allow staged provisioning over 14 days.

Marissa — can you prepare the DocuSign packet with the following:
- PO header updated to NC-PO-2789
- Two invoice lines with due dates 2027-08-31 and 2027-11-29 and a billing note referencing the marketplace private-offer RNW-2027-NIM-0042
- Attach SLA_addendum_NimbleCare.docx as an exhibit and include a signature block for legal acceptance

Neha — please confirm any tax/VAT considerations for NimbleCare (US entity) and if we should include a tax-exempt note. Also confirm whether we need to route the invoice through AWS marketplace billing or produce a Redwood invoice (procurement prefers marketplace billing but will accept Redwood if needed for tranching).

Ben — can you confirm runtime/serving side: staged provisioning over 14 days is fine from our end (we can throttle capacity ramp via routing rules). If there are any constraints on activation windows with the AWS private-offer acceptance, flag them now.

I plan to send the DocuSign by end of day tomorrow once we have the above confirmed. Copying NimbleCare procure address so they see we're moving quickly.

Thanks —
Dylan
